intro.text: Travelling tellers of tales whose stories Siri heard often as a girl in Idris, and which shaped how she pictured Hallandren and other far-off lands.

description.text: In their tales Hallandren was a warm, colorful land and also a place of death, its walls built of skulls splashed with lurid paint. They spoke too of grand cities and strange country in distant lands such as Xaka and Hudres, though only Hallandren was given a jungle.

items.text: The stories left Siri grateful for her quiet life in Idris. Once in Hallandren, she found the ramblemen had exaggerated a great deal.
